support_claim: The contract names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, billing records bill Meridian Energy Partners LLC, and commercial notes tie Meridian invoices to the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because documentary evidence—not mere name compatibility—links the billing referent billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC to the counterparty denoted by contract:MSA-MER-2024: the contract header identifies that legal counterparty, invoices bill that same name, and commercial notes connect those invoices to services under that contract.
